purpose: Engineering feasibility, not final biodiversity evaluation
selection: One UTC session uniformly sampled per UTC month; then one recording uniformly sampled within that session.
interval_selection: All 60 consecutive one-minute intervals per file
evaluation_policy: Pilot sessions reserved for development; remaining sessions unassigned. No final evaluation split created.
limitations: Small feasibility sample; not a representative ecological survey.
Unequal recording inclusion probabilities from two-stage sampling.
Do not replace a selected recording because it is quiet or difficult.
